item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 24/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be generally fine over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Visibility will be relatively low in some areas. It will be hot during the day. A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week. The weather will be relatively humid. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of this week. It will become cool appreciably with a few showers over the region. There may be thunderstorms over inland areas. Under the influence of the monsoon, it will remain cool in the morning over Guangdong early next week.
